value.rationale: Worst-case-optimized mixing is strictly worse than Proportional in the natural uniform sample model, and a sharp three-site population-mass threshold reverses this choice. The exact population-sampling Gaussian variance quantifies confidence in observed approximation costs separately from mechanism randomization. The improvement is an interpretable decision boundary, not just a tiny unexplained numerical gain.
